en.topic_title: Taiwan ‘preparing for the worst’ as China begins live-fire drills
en.topic_summary:
Taiwan will “closely monitor” Chinese live-fire drills off China’s coast this week, the democratic island’s defence minister said on Monday.



An AIDC T-5 Brave Eagle transonic advanced jet trainer craft lands at Taiwan’s Gangshan Air Force Base. Photo: Taiwan Ministry of National Defense.



Chinese maritime authorities announced in recent days that drills would be held from October 12-20 in the Bohai Sea, Yellow Sea, East China Sea and South China Sea.
